mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as input costs rise and margins compress.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST rises by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate UNRATE is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX posts negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is above 4% and rising by more than 0.5pp over the past 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over the past 3 months and payroll employment PAYEMS falls by more than 100,000 over the same period, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures RSAFS, falling by more than 2% month-over-month, signals a sudden demand shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumption accounts for ~70% of GDP.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX posts positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month and the industrial production index INDPRO is flat or falling year-over-year, it signals a stagflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL m-o-m change > 0.5% AND INDPRO y-o-y change <= 0%
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.
